name: council
description: Multi-perspective council for one open decision, including architecture selection when a draft exists and the goal is to choose rather than edit. Incumbent-draft mode adopts a neutral brief, runs blind challenger search, then reveals and compares the draft. Capable hosts may reach CONVERGED; weaker hosts return unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY. Use review-loop to fix artifacts to APPROVE. Requires ~/.agency-agents.

interface.shortDescription: Draft-aware CONVERGED or non-authorizing ADVISORY council.
interface.longDescription: Seat one agency-agents specialist per named viewpoint gap and debate one open decision. For an existing architecture draft, first adopt a neutral brief and run incumbent-blind challenger search, then reveal and compare the draft without editing it. Canonical records enable audited CONVERGED; weaker hosts produce unaudited, non-authorizing ADVISORY.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to weigh this decision from several expert perspectives.
